images_rating.description: images.rating — derived from score_general thresholds; never used as ground truth

grouped_cv_dev.equation: P(a ≻ b) = σ(Σ_j β_j · Δ_j(a,b))  (no intercept; Δ standardized by pooled SD)

candidate_q_global.equation: Q_global = β0 + Σ_j β_j · z_j  (z = standardized score; ridge, grouped CV by cluster)

thresholds.global: lower 95% CI of burst-weighted Spearman(score, global label) ≥ 0.3
thresholds.culling: lower 95% CI of macro pairwise accuracy within clusters ≥ 0.6
